name: McKinsey & Company
seo_title: McKinsey interview process: what to expect
description: What has been published about McKinsey & Company's recruiting, including its Solve assessment and its rules on using AI when you apply.
intro: This guide is meant to sum up what McKinsey & Company publishes about its recruiting process. McKinsey's careers site could not be reached when we checked on 15 October 2026, so for now this page covers only a few points reported by Fortune, with the date of each report. Check McKinsey's own careers pages for the current process before you apply.

items.text: In a Fortune interview published in February 2023, McKinsey's chief people officer described Solve as a video game the firm uses to test candidates' problem-solving.
She said Solve was designed so that people can show their problem-solving ability without the kind of preparation a McKinsey case interview takes, and without needing to know business terms.
In the same February 2023 interview, she said that many candidates spend a great deal of time preparing for McKinsey's case interview.
Fortune reported in January 2026 that McKinsey's careers page encourages candidates to use AI to refine their CVs and practise interview questions.
According to the same report, McKinsey says AI must not be used during assessments or to generate interview answers, and that embellishment is not allowed.

sources.title: McKinsey is using a video game to recruit more diverse talent | Fortune

practice_advice: Practise saying your structure out loud before you start any analysis, so the interviewer can follow your plan.
Do short, timed mental maths drills most days. CaseSpar's drills cover mental maths, chart reading and market sizing.
Run full practice cases from the opening question to a final recommendation, and finish each one with a summary of a minute or less.
Prepare two or three stories from your own experience, each with a clear situation, what you did and the result, and practise telling each in about two minutes.
After every practice case, write down one thing to improve and focus on it in the next one.
